_comment: Tier-2 for dune::linear_elasticity#2 and _general.natural_bc_measured.Signal_pointwise_indicator. The elasticity form is character-for-character the one in componentwise_bc_corner_drops_a_constraint so the compiled module is shared; wall time 114 s on 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2), of which one build is the extra-BC variant. Measured on a 4x4 dimRange=2 grid with u_x=0 on x=0 and u_y=0 on y=0: the corner dof reads 1.909986e-06, 0.0. Adding DirichletBC(space,[0,0], And(x[0]<tol, x[1]<tol)) to pin that node was ACCEPTED and changed the solution by EXACTLY 0.0 — the corner value is unchanged to every printed digit. Two controls make that null result mean something: an EDGE-sized BC (u_y=0 on the top edge, an edge the base does not already constrain in that component) moved the solution by 2.010541e-06, and walking the 16 boundary facets found ZERO whose centre satisfies both coordinate tests — which is the geometric reason. Note an edge-sized BC on an edge the base ALREADY constrains changes nothing either, because component-wise masks on the same edge merge; that is why the control uses a different edge. STRENGTHENED after mutation testing: the fixture originally asserted only that the point BC changes nothing, which an indicator REDUNDANT with an existing BC also satisfies — a mutation replacing the point test with the already-constrained bottom edge passed. It now also asserts that the corner dof is NOT zero, i.e. the constraint the caller wrote was not honoured. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): MUTATION APPLIED AND IT DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE. T2_MUTATE=1 replaces the point indicator with Or(x[0]<tol, x[1]<tol), which selects the two boundary edges meeting at the corner -- the most direct removal of the pathology available, since the indicator now does select facets and those facets do contain the corner node. The fixture STILL PASSES. Measured 2026-08-06: appending that BC changed the solution by 0.000000e+00 and left the corner at 1.909986e-06, prepending it changed it by 0.000000e+00, and scheme.dirichletBlocks reported the SAME 23 constrained entries in both cases and in the point-indicator case; a scheme carrying ONLY that BC did constrain the corner (max change 4.772543e-06, corner 0, 0). So the null result this fixture reports is not attributable to 'a point indicator selects no facet': an extra DirichletBC on facets the scheme already constrains contributes nothing whatever its indicator, in either list order, and the corner_is_not_zero strengthening added in the earlier round does not close that hole. What IS decisive here is the direct geometric count further down -- facet_centres_satisfying_the_point_test=0 out of boundary_facets=16 -- which counts the thing being claimed instead of standing in for it. The mutation is left in source.py so the negative result is re-runnable: `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py`. ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
